description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different categories of knowledge as perceived by various language models. The horizontal axis represents the categories, which include Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis indicates the popularity, measured on a scale from 0 to 220. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different language model: Llama3, Owen2, and ChatGPT. Additionally, the bars are patterned to show different accuracy levels: Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and Acc=1 & GT Ans. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized. The chart does not provide any annotations or additional information beyond the visual representation of the data.
